# Delivery protocol 1 fixtures

`preview-17` and `preview-18` contain synthetic selected-order export deliveries generated by the actual tagged Aimship implementations (`v0.1.0-preview.17` and `v0.1.0-preview.18`). No company or real user delivery data is used. Each has two completed implementation batches and passing batch reviews, four synthetically approved design documents, and pending overall review, verification and handoff. Synthetic approvals are test evidence only.

Generation used each tag's own state functions, document fixture writer and approval fixture driver: normalize generated formal Markdown to one final newline before initialization/review, initialize under a temporary data root, finish and approve requirements/design/cases/plan, then finish both implementation/review pairs through revision-checked updates. The installation-specific `storage` metadata was omitted when saving the portable fixtures. Generated status links use `/synthetic/delivery` instead of the temporary generation directory, with the view hash recomputed; this is display metadata only. State identity, timestamps, revision, stage history, approval records, document bytes and digests were retained. Tests copy the fixtures to a temporary directory; they never modify these baseline files.

These are immutable regression evidence for exact legacy protocol identification. Current schema-5/protocol-3 tools must reject continuation and rendering of them while preserving their bytes; no migration or metadata relabeling is performed. The package ships neither fixtures nor the test approval driver.

`preview-19` is generated by the actual v0.1.0-preview.19 state and approval functions. It has six business implementation/review pairs, a failed overall review, one untyped legacy repair implementation, passing batch/overall rechecks and a failed verification followed by a passing RUN retaining the failure reference. Handoff is pending. It deliberately has no new workType metadata and remains a protocol-1 negative fixture. Current tools must not infer a schema-5 business registry or mutate it into the new workflow. All content and decisions remain synthetic; no user delivery is copied.

`preview-23` was generated by the exact published preview.23 source (50ff3b5) using its native synthetic delivery helper, with four design approvals (8 history entries). Only the local storage root was anonymized to /synthetic/aimship/protocol2; authored document/evidence bytes and their fingerprints are unchanged; generated location displays are anonymized as well. It represents schema5/protocol2 outlines and generated parents. It must also be rejected unchanged by protocol3.
